core_concept: High-Ticket Aesthetic, 100% Scientific Accuracy, Gamified Revenue Engine

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-bold font-serif
hierarchy.labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium font-sans text-[#D4AF37]

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Sovereign 8 Matrix: A 2x4 grid layout. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6 or gap-8.

surfaces.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-[40px] bg-[#020617]/40 border border-[#D4AF37]/20 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] rounded-2xl

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-aligned data tables, centered tarot cards and circular charts.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#020617] font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-none hover:bg-[#F3E5AB] hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.6)] transition-all duration-300 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] py-3 px-6 rounded-none hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 transition-colors uppercase tracking-widest text-sm
buttons.view_logic: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-2 text-white/50 hover:text-[#D4AF37] transition-colors bg-transparent border-none cursor-pointer

components.power_meter: Circular or semi-circular SVG gauge (0-100%). Uses stroke-dasharray for progress with a glowing #D4AF37 stroke and text inside showing 'Dominance Level'.
components.tarot_cards: 3D flip implementation using Framer Motion (rotateY). Front: Glassmorphic arcane design. Back: Dark metallic pattern.
components.charts: Astrology charts (D1, D9, D10) must use high-contrast SVG paths. Include 'Liquid Gold' flow animations using Framer Motion pathLength animations.
components.ads: Free Tier Native Advanced Ads must blend with the UI: #020617 background, #D4AF37 border, marked clearly as 'Sponsored Insight'.

animations.card_hover: Hover state should lift element -translate-y-1 and intensify the border glow (border-[#D4AF37]/60).
animations.liquid_gold_flow: SVG paths should animate from 0 to 1 over 2 seconds using an easeInOut curve.
animations.page_transition: Fade in with a slight upward drift (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0).

image_urls.description: Abstract liquid gold and black swirls for the main landing or dashboard background.
Milky Way galaxy background for the Synastry War-Room or Zodiac charts.
Visual background for 'The Oracle's Trial' Tarot Game.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, representing the role (e.g., data-testid='generate-d1-chart-button', data-testid='power-meter-gauge').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Playfair Display and Outfit fonts.
Implement the Sovereign 8 layout using Tailwind CSS Grid on the Dashboard.
Use Framer Motion for the Tarot Card 3D flip haptic effects and Kundali Liquid Gold SVG line drawing animations.
Ensure all generated charts (Vedic, Western, Chinese, Numerology) have a 'View Logic' button.
For the Free tier, stub out AdMob Native Advanced ad slots styled with Obsidian backgrounds and Gold borders.
Ensure glassmorphism is achieved using backdrop-blur-[40px] with a very subtle background tint (bg-[#020617]/40) and gold border.
Use lucide-react for iconography, prioritizing clean, thin strokes.
